faqQuestion: How is a settlement agreement payout calculated under UK employment law?
faqAnswer: Under UK employment law and the Employment Rights Act 1996, statutory redundancy is capped at £751 per week, while genuine compensation up to £30,000 is tax-free under Section 403 of ITEPA 2003. Your employer covers the legal fees for your independent solicitor review.
